Gifted: Smoke Body.name: Gifted: Smoke Body
Gifted: Smoke Body.description:
🧬 Smoke Body, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start one limb can curl through a grille or billow across someone's view.
📈 With training: a whole-body drift through vents, a moving screen for a rescue team, and a room-wide choice of where to re-form.
⚠️ Wind scatters you. Solid parts can still be struck. In full smoke you cannot hit, hold, or carry anything, and every route needs an opening.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit. If chosen, your outline starts returning as your time in smoke runs out.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mirio Togata (Permeation) for evasive timing and En (Smokescreen) for cover.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Smoke Body.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Smoke Body family): Scale: One limb smokes at first. Training lets the whole body drift with local air along a continuous open route. Only the body and fitted Quirk suit change. Limits: Fans split the cloud and force it to gather downwind before re-forming. Solid parts stay exposed. Full smoke cannot carry, grasp or strike. Cannot climb still air or cross a seal. A smoke part turns solid again only on the user's next turn: it cannot grip, flip or carry anything before then. Quirk Strain: light: Cinderless Sleeve, Cuff Cloud; moderate: Hollow Shoulder, Underdoor Eddy, Curtain Call Drift; heavy: Duct Runner, Gray Switchback, Still Foot Feint, Procession Veil, Grate to Grate; severe: House of Smoke. Type: Transformation. Law: Drifting through a locked building's vents can count as trespass. Look: Gray whorls carry the outline of the last part to turn.
